answer_1.quote: We train UDR on a wide range of NLP tasks, consisting of about 40 tasks across 13 task families and multiple data domains, including: ... Text Summarization: CNN/DailyMail, PubMed and Reddit ; Commonsense Generation: CommonGen ; Story Generation: Roc Story and Ending Generation ; Code Summarization: Go, Python, Java and PHP ; Text Simplification: WikiAuto + Turk/ASSET ; Data to Text: DART and E2E .
answer_1.outputs: Retrieval of task-specific demonstrations to be used as in-context examples for large language models
